message.content:
This document is a technical README for Project Maya, a system for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally. Key technical points:

**Models & Memory**
- Three model families with quantized variants (Maya-XS/S/M/L) sized from 93 GB to 470 GB; all run on NVIDIA V100/RTX 20+, AMD, and Windows.
- Quality: Maya quants retain 97.7–99.2% of FP8 zero-shot accuracy; next-token
